common_evidence_points: The source is an official HSE primary guidance page under the UK public-sector hse.gov.uk domain.
The page was live-opened successfully on 1 August 2026.
The URL passed the official HSE domain allowlist.
The URL was absent from all nine repository slug-uniqueness query groups for the previous 1,079 source families.
Its scope is source-specific and should not be generalised beyond the stated workplace, event, establishment, equipment, task, dutyholder or reporting function.
Operational use requires confirmation of the current page version, responsible persons, site and equipment characteristics, affected people, timing and supporting evidence.
A checklist, report, notification, inspection or risk assessment alone does not establish that every legal or safety requirement has been satisfied.
Final decisions require the current official scope plus exact hazard, exposure, engineering, operational, competence, emergency, reporting, communication, governance and review evidence.
